title: United Kingdom Postal Sectors
text:
United Kingdom Postal Sectors

Postal sector codes for the United Kingdom supported by 
UNICEDE
/2.
For the full list of valid U.K. postal sectors, go to 
 
UNICEDE
 website, then select "Download Area and
 Subarea Codes" from the 
UNICEDE
/2 menu. When the spreadsheet opens, select "UK" from the
 table of contents.
